scope: loopback-only freshness guard check; no store, settings, credentials or other network

checks.name: a fresh open hands on its own response: the goto's navigation event arrives before goto resolves
a hash change the page makes spoils it
a pushState the page makes spoils it
a child frame navigating leaves it current
another page, another address and a closed page are refused
a later open spends the earlier handoff
the status check holds and hands nothing on
